description: What running this gerp costs on AWS: month to date (or last month, or a range) by service, the total, and the invoice estimate at the disclosed markup. Read when the owner asks what this costs.

period.description: this_month (default, month to date through yesterday) or last_month. For an explicit window pass range instead.

range.description: An explicit window instead of period: ISO dates, end exclusive, not past today.
